probes.summary: Read-only validation completed across all four nodes. Roles, joins, replication, DNS, identities, and controller state were inspected.
Kerberos-required SMB access and evaluator file I/O succeeded through files.corp.example. Evaluator cache, temporary files, and share file were removed; welcome.txt was preserved.
limitations: An initial evaluator cache command used an unexported shell variable and failed to store credentials; the corrected retry succeeded.

probes.summary: Operational residue and service state were inspected on all four nodes.

assertions.summary: Both controllers are active CORP.EXAMPLE AD DCs on the 10.83.0.0/24 identity network; node3 is a joined member server and node4 is a joined client using both identity-network resolvers.

evidence.command: hostname -f; ip -4 -brief addr; systemctl is-active samba-ad-dc 2>&1; sudo -n -H samba-tool domain level show 2>&1; sudo -n testparm -s 2>&1
evidence.observation: dc1.corp.example has 10.83.0.10/24; samba-ad-dc is active; domain is DC=corp,DC=example; testparm reports ROLE_ACTIVE_DIRECTORY_DC, realm CORP.EXAMPLE, workgroup CORP, and interfaces lo 10.83.0.10.

evidence.command: hostname -f; ip -4 -brief addr; systemctl is-active samba-ad-dc 2>&1; sudo -n -H samba-tool domain level show 2>&1; sudo -n testparm -s 2>&1
evidence.observation: dc2.corp.example has 10.83.0.11/24; samba-ad-dc is active; domain is DC=corp,DC=example; testparm reports ROLE_ACTIVE_DIRECTORY_DC, realm CORP.EXAMPLE, workgroup CORP, and interfaces lo 10.83.0.11.

evidence.command: hostname -f; ip -4 -brief addr; systemctl is-active smbd 2>&1; systemctl is-active winbind 2>&1; sudo -n testparm -s 2>&1; sudo -n -H net ads info 2>&1; sudo -n -H net ads testjoin 2>&1; sudo -n -H wbinfo -t 2>&1; cat /etc/resolv.conf; getent hosts dc1.corp.example dc2.corp.example 2>&1
evidence.observation: files.corp.example has 10.83.0.12/24; smbd and winbind are active; testparm reports ROLE_DOMAIN_MEMBER, realm CORP.EXAMPLE, workgroup CORP, and identity-only interface 10.83.0.12; net ads reports Join is OK and trust-secret validation succeeds; resolvers are 10.83.0.10 and 10.83.0.11.

evidence.command: hostname -f; ip -4 -brief addr; systemctl is-active winbind 2>&1; sudo -n -H net ads info 2>&1; sudo -n -H net ads testjoin 2>&1; sudo -n -H wbinfo -t 2>&1; cat /etc/resolv.conf; getent hosts dc1.corp.example dc2.corp.example 2>&1
evidence.observation: client.corp.example has 10.83.0.13/24; winbind is active; net ads reports CORP.EXAMPLE and Join is OK with trust-secret validation succeeding; resolvers are 10.83.0.10 and 10.83.0.11.

assertions.summary: Both controllers report bidirectional successful replication for all required naming contexts, with zero consecutive failures and clean dbcheck results.

evidence.command: sudo -n -H samba-tool drs showrepl 2>&1; sudo -n -H samba-tool dbcheck --cross-ncs --quiet 2>&1; RC=$?; printf 'dbcheck_exit=%s\n' "$RC"
evidence.observation: Inbound and outbound ForestDnsZones, DomainDnsZones, Domain, Configuration, and Schema neighbors replicate with DC2; every displayed attempt is successful with 0 consecutive failures; dbcheck_exit=0.

evidence.command: sudo -n -H samba-tool drs showrepl 2>&1; sudo -n -H samba-tool dbcheck --cross-ncs --quiet 2>&1; RC=$?; printf 'dbcheck_exit=%s\n' "$RC"
evidence.observation: Inbound and outbound ForestDnsZones, DomainDnsZones, Domain, Configuration, and Schema neighbors replicate with DC1; every displayed attempt is successful with 0 consecutive failures; dbcheck_exit=0.

assertions.summary: node1 has a complete SYSVOL tree, but node2 is missing the Policies directory and fails its live SYSVOL ACL check.

evidence.command: sudo -n -H samba-tool ntacl sysvolcheck 2>&1; sudo -n find /var/lib/samba/sysvol/corp.example -maxdepth 2 -type d -print 2>&1; sudo -n stat -c '%n %A %U:%G' /var/lib/samba/sysvol/corp.example /var/lib/samba/sysvol/corp.example/Policies /var/lib/samba/sysvol/corp.example/scripts 2>&1
evidence.observation: No sysvolcheck error was emitted; SYSVOL contains Policies, both required policy GUID directories, and scripts; the domain directories are accessible with root:BUILTIN administrators ACL ownership.

evidence.command: sudo -n -H samba-tool ntacl sysvolcheck 2>&1; sudo -n find /var/lib/samba/sysvol/corp.example -maxdepth 2 -type d -print 2>&1; sudo -n stat -c '%n %A %U:%G' /var/lib/samba/sysvol/corp.example /var/lib/samba/sysvol/corp.example/Policies /var/lib/samba/sysvol/corp.example/scripts 2>&1
evidence.observation: sysvolcheck reports OSError No data available for /var/lib/samba/sysvol/corp.example; only the root and scripts directories exist; stat reports Policies does not exist and the remaining directories are root:root.

failures: Confirmed executor defect: node2's CORP.EXAMPLE SYSVOL is incomplete and its live ntacl sysvolcheck fails because Policies is absent.

assertions.summary: engineering and infrasetuser exist on both controllers, and infrasetuser is a member of engineering on both.

evidence.command: sudo -n -H samba-tool group listmembers engineering 2>&1; sudo -n -H samba-tool user show infrasetuser 2>&1 | grep -E '^(dn|sAMAccountName|memberOf|objectClass):' 2>&1
evidence.observation: engineering lists infrasetuser; user output shows DN CN=infrasetuser,CN=Users,DC=corp,DC=example, sAMAccountName infrasetuser, and memberOf CN=engineering,CN=Users,DC=corp,DC=example.

evidence.command: sudo -n -H samba-tool group listmembers engineering 2>&1; sudo -n -H samba-tool user show infrasetuser 2>&1 | grep -E '^(dn|sAMAccountName|memberOf|objectClass):' 2>&1
evidence.observation: engineering lists infrasetuser; user output shows DN CN=infrasetuser,CN=Users,DC=corp,DC=example, sAMAccountName infrasetuser, and memberOf CN=engineering,CN=Users,DC=corp,DC=example.

assertions.summary: node4 obtained a CORP.EXAMPLE Kerberos ticket and, using the DNS/SPN-derived files.corp.example identity with Kerberos required, read welcome.txt and completed SMB create, modify, read, and cleanup I/O with engineering ownership semantics.

evidence.command: sudo -n -H net ads search -P '(&(objectClass=computer)(sAMAccountName=FILES$))' dNSHostName servicePrincipalName 2>&1; sudo -n testparm -sv 2>&1; dig +time=2 +tries=1 +short @dc1.corp.example A "$FQDN" 2>&1; dig +time=2 +tries=1 +short @dc2.corp.example A "$FQDN" 2>&1
evidence.observation: The member identity is files.corp.example; both dc1.corp.example and dc2.corp.example resolve it to 10.83.0.12. AD returns HOST/files and RestrictedKrbHost/files principals, and effective share configuration uses /srv/corp/engineering, valid users and write list restricted to the CORP engineering group, force group engineering, and acl_xattr.

sudo -n -H sh -c '. /root/corp-user.env; test -n "${SAMBA_USER:-}" && test -n "${SAMBA_PASSWORD:-}"; printf "credential_env=present

evidence.command: sudo -n stat -c '%n %U:%G %A mode=%a' /srv/corp/engineering/welcome.txt 2>&1; sudo -n sh -c 'cat /srv/corp/engineering/welcome.txt' 2>&1; sudo -n stat -c '%n %U:%G %A mode=%a' /srv/corp/engineering/.__infraset_eval_20260826_2039.txt 2>&1; sudo -n getfacl -p /srv/corp/engineering /srv/corp/engineering/.__infraset_eval_20260826_2039.txt 2>&1
evidence.observation: welcome.txt contains infraset-samba and is root:engineering mode 660. The SMB-created file was infrasetuser:engineering mode 770; ACLs grant engineering rwx and deny other::---.

assertions.summary: Required Samba functionality works, but concrete failed, stale, and residue state remains on the nodes.

evidence.command: systemctl --failed --no-legend --no-pager 2>&1; systemctl is-active ssh 2>&1; systemctl is-enabled ssh 2>&1; systemctl status --no-pager --full ssh.service 2>&1; journalctl -u ssh.service -n 20 --no-pager 2>&1; journalctl -u samba-ad-dc -p err..alert -b --no-pager 2>&1
evidence.observation: ssh.service is enabled but failed; sshd logs say no hostkeys available -- exiting. Samba logs contain repeated gssapi access-denied and samba_dnsupdate TSIG verify failure/update REFUSED errors.

evidence.command: systemctl --failed --no-legend --no-pager 2>&1; systemctl is-active ssh 2>&1; systemctl is-enabled ssh 2>&1; sudo -n find /var/lib/samba -xdev -type f \( -iname '*.bak' -o -iname '*.old' -o -iname '*debug*' -o -iname '*provision*' \) -print 2>&1
evidence.observation: ssh.service is enabled but failed. The controller otherwise exposes required Samba database files; no cleanup action was authorized for the failed management service.

evidence.command: systemctl --failed --no-legend --no-pager 2>&1; sudo -n grep -RInE '^[[:space:]]*(default_realm|kdc|admin_server|realm|workgroup|server[[:space:]]+role|password[[:space:]]+server)' /etc/krb5.conf /etc/samba 2>&1; sudo -n find /var/lib/samba -xdev -type f \( -iname '*.bak' -o -iname '*.old' -o -iname '*.orig' -o -iname '*copy*' -o -iname '*debug*' -o -iname '*provision*' \) -print 2>&1
evidence.observation: ssh.service is failed. /etc/samba/smb.conf.pre-join retains WORKGROUP and standalone-server state alongside the active CORP configuration. winbindd_cache.tdb.bak and winbindd_cache.tdb.bak.old remain.

evidence.command: systemctl --failed --no-legend --no-pager 2>&1; sudo -n stat -c '%n %A %U:%G' /root/corp-user.env 2>&1; sudo -n grep -RInE '^[[:space:]]*(default_realm|kdc|admin_server|realm|workgroup|server[[:space:]]+role|password[[:space:]]+server)' /etc/krb5.conf /etc/samba 2>&1; sudo -n find /var/lib/samba -xdev -type f \( -iname '*.bak' -o -iname '*.old' -o -iname '*.orig' -o -iname '*copy*' -o -iname '*debug*' -o -iname '*provision*' \) -print 2>&1
evidence.observation: ssh.service is failed. The required /root/corp-user.env exists with mode 600 and was not treated as residue; /etc/samba/smb.conf.pre-join retains WORKGROUP and standalone-server state, and both winbindd cache backup files remain.

failures: Confirmed executor defect: ssh.service is enabled and failed on all four nodes; node1 records sshd no hostkeys available -- exiting.
node1 has current-boot Samba DNS update TSIG verification failures and REFUSED updates in its journal.
node3 and node4 retain stale /etc/samba/smb.conf.pre-join configurations and winbindd_cache.tdb.bak/.old residue.
node2 also retains the incomplete SYSVOL state reported by the dedicated SYSVOL assertion.

actions_performed: Collected the authored read-only domain, replication, SYSVOL, identity, join, DNS, and operational-state evidence on node1 through node4.
Created only evaluator-owned Kerberos cache and SMB test data, performed Kerberos-required SMB I/O, and removed the cache, temporary files, and evaluator share file while preserving welcome.txt.
Called mcp__infraset__complete_evidence exactly once after all checks and cleanup; no live tools were called afterward.
overall_summary: Four assertions pass and two fail. Roles/joins, directory replication, required identities, and Kerberos SMB share access pass. SYSVOL health fails because node2 lacks Policies, and operational cleanliness fails because failed SSH services, Samba DNS-update errors, stale pre-join configuration, and backup residue remain.
